title: 和可被 K 整除的子数组
summary: 统计非空连续子数组中元素和能被 k 整除的数量。
insight: 子数组和可整除当且仅当两端前缀和模 k 相同；扫描时累加此前同余数出现次数，再记录当前余数。
pitfalls: 初始前缀余数零出现一次
负前缀和余数要规范到 0..k-1
计数结果在题目范围内用整数即可

solutions.title: 前缀余数频次
solutions.idea: 把可整除子数组转化为同余前缀对。

code.java: class Solution { public int subarraysDivByK(int[] nums,int k){int[] frequency=new int[k];frequency[0]=1;int remainder=0,answer=0;for(int value:nums){remainder=((remainder+value)%k+k)%k;answer+=frequency[remainder]++;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun subarraysDivByK(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Int{val frequency=IntArray(k);frequency[0]=1;var remainder=0;var answer=0;for(value in nums){remainder=((remainder+value)%k+k)%k;answer+=frequency[remainder]++};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int subarraysDivByK(vector<int>& nums,int k){vector<int> frequency(k);frequency[0]=1;int remainder=0,answer=0;for(int value:nums){remainder=((remainder+value)%k+k)%k;answer+=frequency[remainder]++;}return answer;} };
